name: SDN GP Archive Records
description: Re-builds the GP history archive's $MPE element sets and $CAT catalog rows in archive encoding v1: the exact byte layout the archive's content IDs (sha256 over the record bytes) depend on. Takes a size-prefixed $MPE or $CAT record stream in any builder layout, reads each record's values in place through the generated SDS accessors, and builds it again with the schema-generated SDS C++ builders; the field order and default handling are a compatibility contract gated by fixture bytes from the importer's original builder. Pure compute; output bytes depend only on the input values.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each record is encoded independently in one bounded pass; the module starts no workers. Hosts parallelize by invoking separate instances on separate batches.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $MPE record stream ([u32le length][$MPE] frames; zero-length prefixes are padding). Each record must carry ENTITY_ID, EPOCH, MEAN_MOTION, ECCENTRICITY, INCLINATION, RA_OF_ASC_NODE, ARG_OF_PERICENTER, MEAN_ANOMALY and BSTAR written (force-defaults, so 0.0 and -0.0 stay distinct; EPOCH in Unix seconds, UTC); MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY, if written, must be SGP4; any other field (TARGETER) is refused, as archive v1 cannot carry it.

inputPorts.description: One $MPE record stream holding the records to re-build.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $MPE stream: concatenated [u32le length][$MPE buffer] frames, each padded to 8 bytes with zeros (zero-length prefixes are padding). Archive encoding v1: every field written, defaults included, MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY = SGP4.

outputPorts.description: The built records, one per input element, in input order.

methods.description: Builds one $MPE per input $MPE record in archive encoding v1. A malformed stream or record is refused whole.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $CAT record stream ([u32le length][$CAT] frames; zero-length prefixes are padding). Each record must carry OBJECT_ID and OBJECT_NAME (bytes kept exactly); NORAD_CAT_ID may be absent (0); any other field is refused, as archive v1 cannot carry it.

inputPorts.description: One $CAT record stream holding the records to re-build.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Size-prefixed $CAT stream: concatenated [u32le length][$CAT buffer] frames, each padded to 8 bytes with zeros (zero-length prefixes are padding). Archive encoding v1: OBJECT_ID, NORAD_CAT_ID and OBJECT_NAME, defaults omitted.

outputPorts.description: The built records, one per input element, in input order.

methods.description: Builds one $CAT per input $CAT record in archive encoding v1. A malformed stream or record is refused whole.
